memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then they turned around and attacked Debir. They took the city, its king and its villages, and put them to the sword. Everyone in it they totally destroyed. They left no survivors. They did to Debir and its king as they had done to Libnah and its king and to the city of Hebron. — Josh 10:38-39 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
With the taking of Debir, the southern campaign draws to its close. Looking back over this whole chapter, we see a remarkable sweep of victories, city after city falling before Israel. And through it all, one truth has been quietly repeated: the Lord gave these cities into Israel's hands. What began with five kings gathering in fearsome alliance ended with the entire southern region subdued under God's power.

There is encouragement here in seeing the big picture. In the midst of the campaign, each battle may have felt like its own uncertain struggle. But looking back over the whole, a clear pattern emerges: God was faithful at every step. Not one battle was lost. Not one promise failed. The God who said "I have given them into your hand" proved true, city after city.

Often we cannot see this pattern while we are in the middle of our struggles. Each individual battle feels uncertain and hard. But when we look back over the whole journey, we can trace God's faithful hand through all of it. The victories we could not have imagined at the start have been won, one by one, by the Lord who fights for His people.

This invites us to pause and look back over our own lives. When we trace the whole story rather than fixating on the current battle, we often see how faithfully God has carried us. "The Lord has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy" (Ps 126:3). The God who was faithful through Israel's whole campaign is the same God who has been faithful through all of ours, and He will be faithful to the end.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. When you look back over your life, can you trace God's faithful hand through it all?
2. How does seeing the "big picture" of God's faithfulness encourage you in your current battle?
3. What "great things" has the Lord done for you that you can pause to remember?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, help me look back and see Your faithful hand through my whole story, not just my present struggle. Thank You for the great things You have done, and will yet do. Amen.
